recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait of a figure whose head is entirely encased in a sheer, white, translucent fabric. Beneath the fabric, the face is obscured by a dense arrangement of vibrant cobalt blue and off-white flower petals. The figure wears multiple diamond-encrusted chains and a white tank top, revealing intricate dark tattoos on the shoulder and back. The background is a flat, matte charcoal grey.
coreVisualRelationships: The tension between the tight, sheer fabric and the organic volume of the petals underneath.
The high contrast between the saturated cobalt blue petals and the neutral grey background.
The juxtaposition of luxury jewelry and rough skin tattoos against delicate floral elements.
coreInvariants: Translucent white fabric wrap creating highlights and shadows
Matte, desaturated background to emphasize subject saturation

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale bust portrait positioned slightly off-center to the right, facing left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cluster of cobalt blue petals near the center of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vibrant blue petals, follows the curve of the head down to the diamond chains, and moves along the tattooed shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive flat grey space on the left side of the frame provides breathing room for the complex subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cobalt blue (petals) providing the primary visual pop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm brown skin tones and silver/white highlights from the jewelry.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue petals against a low-saturation, medium-value background.

graphicDevices: Sharp detail on jewelry and petal textures

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a profile portrait of a person with dark skin and tattoos on their shoulder. The head should be wrapped in thin, sheer white silk. Under the silk, replace the face with a cluster of blue and white rose petals. The background should be a solid, flat dark grey. The lighting should be soft, highlighting the texture of the fabric and the sparkle of diamond necklaces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: No typography required for this visual style.

verificationChecks: Is the face completely hidden by petals?
Is the fabric wrap visibly translucent?
Is the blue of the petals a vivid cobalt?
Is the background a flat, non-distracting grey?

mustRedesign: Specific tattoo motifs (keep generic or abstract)

mustAchieve: Painterly texture in the petal rendering
Clean, sharp edges on the jewelry
avoid: Muddy colors in the blue petals

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fabric looks like it is pressing against the petals.
Check that the diamond chains have realistic specular highlights.
Verify the profile silhouette is clean against the grey background.
Confirm the blue petals are the most saturated element in the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist bust portrait + [Subject Feature: Tattoos/Jewelry] + [Obscuration: Sheer fabric over floral petals] + [Color Pop: Cobalt Blue] + [Background: Matte Neutral].
